title: Colorful Christmas Tree
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1\leq T\leq 20000; 2\leq N\leq 2000; c_i is R, G, or B.; 1\leq u_i,v_i\leq N; When viewing the bulbs as vertices and the ribbons as edges, the given graph is a tree.; T,N,u_i,v_i are integers.; The sum of N^2 in one input file is at most 2000^2.
